prompt: The catalog package lists all 23 items in one response. Add pagination across the layers. repo.list_items(offset=0, limit=None) slices (no arguments still returns everything) and repo.count() returns the total. routes.list_route(query) reads string keys `page` (default 1) and `per_page` (default 10, maximum 50) from the query dict and returns (200, body) with body = {"items": [...], "page": P, "per_page": N, "total": T, "pages": K} where pages is ceil(total/per_page) and at least 1. Non-integer, page < 1, per_page < 1 or per_page > 50 returns (400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}); a page past the last returns (404, {"error": "page out of range"}), except page 1 which is always valid. render.render(body) prints the items one per line followed by a final line `Page P of K (T items)`.
